UI-1.note: Server: relatedUrl validated as http(s) only on POST /api/tickets and owner PATCH /api/tickets/:id (javascript:/data:/vbscript:/ftp → 400, '' → null). Client render guard is the client agent's (TicketDetailPage already changed in WIP commit).

UI-2.note: Ticket number = highest number of the year over ALL tickets incl. soft-deleted (support-storage getHighestTicketNumber), insert retried with the next number on unique violation (parallel creates). Regression test in admin.fix.test.ts.

UI-8.note: Server: group name trimmed 1..50, case-insensitive duplicate → 409 'A group with this name already exists' (GROUP_NAME_TAKEN). Client onError toasts / disabling save for blank names: client agent.

UI-11.note: Server: insertThemeSchema name trimmed 1..60 (blank → 400), colors must be a JSON object. Client-side check in theme-builder: client agent.

ADMIN-1.note: DELETE /api/user/themes/background/:fileRef: strict name pattern theme-bg-u<uid>-<ts>-<rand>.<ext>, uid must be the caller (403 otherwise), path.resolve must stay directly inside uploads/. Uploads are renamed to carry the owner id. Legacy files without owner can no longer be deleted via the API.

ADMIN-2.note: Ticket comment edit/delete: comment must belong to :id, not be a system entry, internal ones owner-only; only the author or ticket staff (owner / 'tickets' permission) may change it; storage updates filter by id AND ticket_id.

ADMIN-3.note: POST /api/admin/bulk/users: zod (int id array 1..100, action enum ban|account|shadow|unban, reason, duration 1..87600); owners and the caller are refused per id; error list contains only fixed texts, no SQL.

ADMIN-4.note: admin-groups router: hasPermission('groups'); validateIdParams; create/patch validated (known permission names only, JSON string or array), 404 for missing groups, 409 duplicate name; non-owners can only create/edit/delete/assign groups whose permissions they hold, never their own group or an owner's; group delete clears adminGroupId of members.

ADMIN-6.note: adminUpdateUserSchema rewritten (enum role, 0/1 flags, length limits, no id/password/createdAt); role/isAdmin changes owner-only; owner accounts untouchable for non-owners; adminGroupId change needs 'groups' + the assignment rules.

ADMIN-7.note: POST /api/tickets: zod whitelist (title, description, type, priority, relatedUrl http(s), relatedUserId/relatedPostId ids); TicketService.createTicket inserts only those fields.

ADMIN-9.note: Stress tests: hasPermission('stress_test'); /api/tickets/stats: hasPermission('tickets'); ticket list/detail show all tickets only to owner or 'tickets' holders.

ADMIN-10.note: All listed admin routes validate input (zod bodies, strict ids via validateIdParams, whitelisted query values) and answer 4xx; 500s go through sendInternalError.

ADMIN-11.note: Revoke of a missing ban → 404; revoke no longer touches karma (bans are not karma, per coordination note INPUT-2/ADMIN-8), it only clears the shadow flag when no other active shadow ban remains; report status is an enum.

ADMIN-12.note: Rule isActive accepts true/false/0/1; frozenUntil accepts ISO strings (and null).

ADMIN-13.note: Bulk reports/posts/users report missing ids as failures; posts action 'hide' removed (only 'delete'); admins cannot bulk-delete owners' posts.

ADMIN-14.note: Activity logger now stores targetType/Id/Label and old/new values; CSV export Admin = username/email, all fields RFC-4180 escaped + formula-neutralised; monitoring limit capped (200) and pages validated; report resolution sets resolvedBy/resolvedAt/resolutionTimeSeconds; ticket list honours page (offset); stats avg resolution handles Postgres Date rows.

INPUT-10.note: tickets, ticket comments, ai/generate (topic/language/imageContext zod), themes PATCH validated with zod; empty theme update → 400. GET /api/posts category is the content agent's.

INPUT-11.note: Theme, auto-punishment-rule and ticket schemas no longer accept id/createdAt/owner fields (themes/communities: themes part done; communities is the content/social agent's).

INPUT-13.note: bans (enum ban_type, id, IP check, duration), group patch/assign, users patch (409 duplicate username/email), reports (404/enum), analytics compute and performance snapshot (invalid date → 400).

INPUT-14.note: leaderboard sortBy/period whitelisted with defaults (service also defaults), logs adminId parseId → 400, monitoring page/limit/userId validated, analytics days clamped 1..365, logs export offset > 10M → 400 (pagination.ts offset cap was also added by core).

AUTHZ-2.note: adminGroupId via PATCH /api/admin/users/:id needs 'groups' and follows checkGroupAssignment (never own group, subset of own permissions).

AUTHZ-3.note: Non-owners get 403 OWNER_PROTECTED for any change to an owner account.

AUTHZ-7.note: hasPermission('tickets') on stats; TicketService.getTickets/getTicketById take canSeeAll = owner or 'tickets' permission.

AUTHZ-11.note: validateIdParams in admin.ts, admin-groups.ts, tickets.ts (id, cId), themes.ts, mod-performance.ts; update/delete of missing rows → 404. Other routers (posts, comments, communities, follow, messages, notifications, reports) are the other agents' — authz suite now 378/378 on my server.

ATK-UPLOAD-1.note: Same as ADMIN-1 (pattern + resolve inside uploads).

ATK-UPLOAD-2.note: Same as ADMIN-1 (owner id in file name, 403 for others).

ATK-RT-8.note: Stress test: test name must exist (404), intensity enum, duration 1..300 s, one run at a time (409), error texts generic.
